description: Nathan and Haley begin married life while Dan recovers from his heart attack and quietly resumes manipulating everyone around him. TRIC gives Peyton and Haley new musical ambitions, Brooke rebuilds her confidence, and Lucas moves closer to Dan as Haley's opportunity to tour puts her marriage under severe strain.

s02e01.description: Lucas and Keith return after Dan's heart attack, while Nathan and Haley's surprise marriage shocks Deb and Brooke and Peyton try to repair their friendship.

s02e02.description: Friends arrange a wedding reception for Nathan and Haley as Deb struggles to accept the marriage and Dan attempts to rebuild damaged family relationships.

s02e03.description: Nathan and Haley endure competing post-wedding parties while Lucas wrestles with visiting Dan and Karen, Keith and Nathan each begin new chapters.

s02e04.description: Brooke meets provocative new neighbor Felix, Nathan and Haley clash over money, Dan's rehabilitation falters and Peyton takes a risky step to launch her club.

s02e05.description: Felix's dare night scrambles the group's relationships, introduces Anna to Lucas and coincides with Peyton confronting her drug mistake and Karen dating Andy.

s02e06.description: A meteor shower gives several new couples room to connect, while Brooke negotiates an arrangement with Felix and Peyton searches for music for her club.

s02e07.description: TRIC opens amid romantic rivalries and family revelations, forcing Haley onto the stage when Chris abandons his performance.

s02e08.description: A girls' sleepover exposes secrets while Lucas and Nathan take a road trip that raises the question of whether Lucas shares Dan's inherited heart condition.

s02e09.description: The school formal rearranges romantic loyalties as Haley's work with Chris strains her marriage and Peyton struggles against the temptation to use drugs.

s02e10.description: Nathan reveals Lucas avoided the heart test, Peyton faces school rumors involving Anna, and the growing distance between Nathan and Haley becomes harder to ignore.

s02e11.description: Haley's sister Taylor arrives carrying an awkward connection to Nathan, while Jake returns to Peyton and Anna finally trusts Lucas with a major secret.

s02e12.description: Nathan admits his past with Taylor while Haley hides her correspondence with Chris, as Lucas battles Karen over medical testing and Keith proposes to Jules.

s02e13.description: Lucas's medical results lead him toward Dan, Haley recognizes how strongly she wants a music career, and Brooke enters the race for student council president.

s02e14.description: Nathan spirals as Haley leaves to pursue music, while Brooke's campaign succeeds and Jake and Peyton finally act on their growing feelings.

s02e15.description: A school time capsule draws private confessions into the open, while Nathan's anger, Peyton and Jake's relationship and Lucas's move toward Dan all intensify.

s02e16.description: Keith and Jules reach their wedding day just as Karen and Andy uncover the truth behind their relationship, while Nathan makes a crucial decision about Haley.

s02e17.description: Keith confronts Dan over Jules, Anna exposes Felix's cruelty, Lucas faces Brooke's possible departure and Nathan sets out to bring Haley home.

s02e18.description: Nathan stops with Taylor after failing to reunite with Haley, while Anna prepares to come out to her parents and Lucas and Andy continue their plan against Dan.

s02e19.description: A racing trip with Cooper turns catastrophic for Nathan, while Deb's addiction worsens and Dan retaliates against Andy and Karen.

s02e20.description: While unconscious after the crash, Nathan imagines a reversed Tree Hill in which Dan chose Karen and Lucas, leaving Nathan to grow up on the outside.

s02e21.description: Nathan returns from hospital to debt and possible eviction, prompting his friends to rally around him before Dan offers help with a punishing condition.

s02e22.description: Lucas and Brooke travel to New York to see Haley, while Dan exploits Deb's addiction and Peyton prepares for Jake's return with a major TRIC performance.

s02e23.description: Lucas moves to expose Dan while confronting his feelings for Brooke, as Peyton faces a threatening voyeur and Nathan and Deb prepare to leave Dan behind.
